name: Tampa
tagline: Waterfront Living, Zero State Tax, and a Booming Food Scene
description: Tampa delivers an irresistible combination of Gulf Coast waterfront living, zero state income tax, and a culinary renaissance that has put the city on the national food map. With year-round warm weather, proximity to world-class beaches, and a rapidly growing downtown, Tampa offers FIRE seekers a vibrant urban lifestyle at a fraction of what comparable coastal cities demand. The city's diverse neighborhoods range from the historic charm of Ybor City to the polished waterfront of Harbour Island, giving retirees real options at every budget level.

quickFacts.visa: No visa required for US citizens
quickFacts.safetyRating: Moderate – varies by neighborhood, improving rapidly downtown
quickFacts.climate: Subtropical with hot, humid summers and warm, mild winters

housing.description: Studio/1BR in Temple Terrace, outer Seminole Heights, or East Tampa (studio avg ~$1,424; cheap 1BR ~$1,350)

dining.description: Cuban sandwich shops and casual spots; mostly home cooking

healthcare.description: A subsidized Silver plan on Florida's ACA marketplace, with the premium capped by income as long as annual income stays under the 2026 subsidy cutoff of about $62,600 for a single person; above that it goes to full price. Priced for an early retiree aged 45-55; older retirees should budget more.

transportation.description: Paid-off used car + FL full coverage (~$300, Tampa high but below Miami) + gas

entertainment.description: Free Riverwalk, bayfront parks, Clearwater/St. Pete beaches

1M.lifestyle: A modest studio or one-bedroom in Temple Terrace, outer Seminole Heights, or East Tampa anchors a frugal but livable stretch of Bay-area retirement. A subsidized ACA plan, held affordable by keeping income under the returned 400%-FPL cliff, and a paid-off car carrying Florida's high auto-insurance rates are the two floors that keep the budget firm, so most meals are cooked at home with Cuban sandwich shops in West Tampa and Ybor City as the affordable treat. The Riverwalk, the bayfront parks, and the beaches at Clearwater and St. Pete cost nothing, and zero state income tax stretches every dollar. Summer air-conditioning is the recurring bill to watch, but the setting is easygoing and warm year-round.

dining.description: Regular dining in South Howard (SoHo) and Ybor City 3-4x/week; weekend brunch at waterfront spots

healthcare.description: Full-price (unsubsidized) low-cost Silver, above the cliff — budget at Tampa Bay's FLOIR benchmark level rather than the bare cheapest plan

transportation.description: Reliable car with full coverage insurance; occasional TECO streetcar rides downtown

entertainment.description: Bucs and Lightning games occasionally, gym membership, paddleboarding on the bay, museum visits

2M.lifestyle: A comfortable one-bedroom in a decent Tampa neighborhood buys an easy commute into the SoHo and Ybor scene. Income has crossed the ACA subsidy cliff, so healthcare moves to a full-price plan, and a reliable newer car with full Florida coverage handles the city. Dining out a few times a week, Lightning games, a gym, and weekend beach trips to Clearwater fit the budget. Zero state income tax keeps the full withdrawal intact, and Tampa's growing cultural offerings add variety beyond the waterfront.

housing.description: Modern 1BR in Channelside, Hyde Park, or Westshore

dining.description: Frequent dining across SoHo and Ybor

healthcare.description: Unsubsidized Hillsborough Silver at full price (above the cliff); FLOIR shows Tampa Bay pricing roughly on par with Sarasota, so budget at benchmark level rather than the cheapest listed plan

3M.lifestyle: A nice modern one-bedroom in Channelside, Hyde Park, or Westshore puts daily life near Tampa's booming restaurant scene and its walkable, growing core. Dining out is frequent across the SoHo and Ybor circuits, and healthcare is a full-price, unsubsidized plan — a heavier line than it first appears, because the Tampa Bay ACA benchmark sits close to the pricier Gulf metros once income clears the subsidy cliff. A late-model car with Florida insurance covers a car-dependent city, with weekend boating on the bay and beach trips to Anna Maria Island built in. Lightning games, a Straz Center subscription, and a premium gym fit comfortably. Zero state income tax keeps the whole withdrawal working.

housing.description: Luxury waterfront-adjacent unit along Bayshore, in Water Street, or in a Hyde Park high-rise

dining.description: Frequent fine dining at the city's best tables

healthcare.description: Rich unsubsidized Gold/PPO plus a direct-primary-care / concierge retainer

transportation.description: Premium car + Tampa Yacht Club slip

5M.lifestyle: A luxury waterfront-adjacent unit along Bayshore, in Water Street, or in a Hyde Park high-rise, with a weekly housekeeper, marks an upper-affluent Tampa life. Fine dining is frequent at the city's best tables, healthcare adds a concierge or direct-primary-care retainer to a rich unsubsidized plan, and a premium car plus a Tampa Yacht Club slip cover the bay. Premium Bucs seats, a country-club membership, and business-class travel are all comfortable. Florida's zero income tax keeps the full withdrawal available at a spending level where Tampa still delivers genuine waterfront living for the money.

housing.description: Waterfront penthouse along Bayshore Boulevard, in Water Street Tampa, or on Davis Islands

healthcare.description: Top-tier unsubsidized PPO plus a concierge retainer; access to Tampa General / Moffitt

entertainment.description: Premium Bucs suite, deep-sea fishing charters

domesticHelp.description: Housekeeping several days a week plus occasional extra help

10M.lifestyle: A waterfront penthouse along Bayshore Boulevard, in Water Street Tampa, or on Davis Islands, kept by housekeeping several days a week, defines life at the top of the Bay area. Dining is a near-daily affair at Bern's, Ulele, and the city's best rooms, healthcare pairs a top-tier plan with a concierge retainer and access to Tampa General and Moffitt, and a luxury vehicle with a yacht-club slip covers the water. A premium suite at Bucs games, a country-club membership, deep-sea fishing charters, and first-class travel are all part of the calendar, with a generous discretionary and philanthropy budget besides. As a genuine metro with real waterfront luxury, Tampa delivers this uncapped life for far less than the big coastal metros would charge, with zero state income tax compounding the advantage.
